label: 1830 Photonic Service Switch 24x
description: 24-slot OTN/packet switch with 1 Tb/s per slot and 24 Tb/s non-blocking switching per shelf (48 Tb/s per shelf pair), multiservice clients from sub-10G to 400GE and coherent uplinks up to 1 Tb/s. Modelled with 4x 10AN1T client cards (client1-client40: 40x QSFP28 100GE/OTU4, two positions per card 400GE-capable) and 2x 1T PSE-Vc line cards (line1-line8: 8x coherent line ports programmable 200G-400G, modelled at this engine's 100G ceiling).
